Author: xRopers
Name: TargetLock
Punchline: The game's lock-on, without the backpedalling.
Description:
Use the game's own lock-on camera exactly as normal, but move like you aren't locked on: run and turn in any direction at full speed instead of being forced to face the target, strafe and slowly backpedal.

Only your movement changes. The lock-on camera, framing and target switching are the game's own.

Commands: /targetlock (settings), /targetlock on|off
